subject: POC kickoff: coordinating multi-team availability & success criteria (Cobalt Financial)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@cobaltfin.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff: coordinating multi-team availability & success criteria (Cobalt Financial)

Hi Marta —

Hope you had a good weekend. We're excited to get the POC kickoff on the calendar for Cobalt Financial. To make the first session productive, we'd like to lock in a 90-minute meeting where we can:

- Introduce project owners (AE/SE + customer engs/procurement/security)
- Walk the shared success criteria and acceptance tests (low-latency search, 99.9% availability for demo window, sample throughput)
- Review timeline and deliverables for the 4-week POC
- Confirm data access and any compliance requirements up front

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Tue, Oct 12: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed, Oct 13: 09:30–11:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu, Oct 14: 11:00–12:30

Please loop in procurement and security people who should attend — we want to avoid last-minute blockers. I've attached a short kickoff agenda and the POC checklist (POC_Checklist.xlsx) so folks can scan before the meeting.

Suggested attendees from our side:
- Laura Bennett (AE) — program owner
- Dev Patel (SE) — technical lead for onboarding
- Sean Gallagher (CS) — success criteria & metrics

If none of the proposed times work, send 2–3 slots that do and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: POC_Checklist.xlsx, Kickoff_Agenda.docx

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@cobaltfin.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Klein <j.klein@cobaltfin.com>, procurement@cobaltfin.com, security_ops@cobaltfin.com
Date: 2026-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: coordinating multi-team availability & success criteria (Cobalt Financial)

Hi Laura —

Thanks — appreciate the clear agenda. Our engineering and security leads are tied up the week of Oct 12–14 with a compliance audit, so those windows won't work for us.

Procurement (copied) needs to confirm budget availability but that's procedural — they should be able to sign off once we agree on scope. Security_ops (copied) will want to review the data-flow diagram and the SOC artifacts before the kickoff. Security has asked for at least 48 hours to review any documents you share.

Alternative slots that look feasible on our side (ET):
- Mon, Oct 18: 13:00–14:30 ET (10:00–11:30 PT)
- Tue, Oct 19: 13:00–14:30 ET (10:00–11:30 PT)
- Thu, Oct 21: 16:00–17:30 ET (13:00–14:30 PT)

If you can do Oct 19 10:00–11:30 PT, that'll line up best with our customer's internal calendar. Also attaching the security_ops inbox so they get the SOC request.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Lead Platform Engineer | Cobalt Financial
marta.ruiz@cobaltfin.com

(On a side note: please include a short data-sanitization checklist if you plan to use production-adjacent samples.)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@cobaltfin.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, security_ops@cobaltfin.com
Date: 2026-10-03T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: coordinating multi-team availability & success criteria (Cobalt Financial)

Thanks Marta —

We can do Tue, Oct 19 at 10:00 PT. A few quick notes from the SE side so procurement and security know what to expect: 

SE pre-reqs (so we don't waste time in the kickoff):
- A sandbox endpoint or a small sample dataset (anonymized) accessible via S3 or secure share
- A named technical point-of-contact with permissions to approve test account access
- Confirmation of allowed IP ranges (if there are egress restrictions)

Proposed success criteria for the initial POC sprint (we'll expand later):
- Demo ingest of 50k records within 48 hours
- Average generation latency under 350ms on the sample queries
- End-to-end demo flow that does not require customer data to leave their VPC (if required)

I've attached our SOC2 high-level summary (SOC2_summary.pdf) and a brief data-sanitization checklist in the Drive link. If security_ops needs additional artifacts, let us know and we'll prioritize.

Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Confirmed: POC kickoff Tue Oct 19 10:00–11:30 PT — agenda & owners

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming Tue, Oct 19, 10:00–11:30 PT (13:00–14:30 ET) for the POC kickoff — I've sent a calendar invite (Calendar_Invite.ics) and added the Zoom link.

Owners and primary agenda:
- Laura Bennett (AE) — program owner, will run introductions and timeline
- Dev Patel (SE) — technical onboarding, demo runbook, data pre-reqs
- Sean Gallagher (CS) — instrumentation and acceptance metrics
- Marta Ruiz (Cobalt) — customer technical lead
- Jared Klein (Cobalt) — procurement contact (will confirm purchasing timeline)
- security_ops@cobaltfin.com — security reviewers

Immediate actions before the kickoff (owners & due dates):
1) Laura: Send HubSpot deal link + NDA/DocuSign (done) — link: https://hubspot.com/deal/HS-8912345 (by EOD 10/05)
2) Dev: Share SOC2_summary.pdf and data-sanitization checklist with security_ops (done)
3) Marta: Provide a sample anonymized dataset or a shareable S3 path (by 10/15)
4) Procurement: Confirm PO/contract cadence after kickoff (by 10/22)

Success criteria we'll validate during the POC (to be signed off in week 2):
- Successful ingest and end-to-end flow against sample dataset
- Throughput target met on 10k qps simulation (scale test)
- Artifacted runbook and rollback plan in the Drive folder

Attachments: Kickoff_Agenda.docx; I've also linked the POC checklist in Drive. If anyone needs to shift the time, speak up today so we can rebook.

Best,
Laura
